name: Custom lists (enumitem)
description: Compact bullets, (a)/(b) labels, "Step 1:" labels and inline lists, all with enumitem.
notes: `noitemsep` removes the gap between items. `nosep` removes every gap, top and bottom included.
Label counters: `\arabic*` 1, `\alph*` a, `\Alph*` A, `\roman*` i, `\Roman*` I.
Inline lists need the `[inline]` package option and the starred environments (`enumerate*`).
